note: Hand-kept map for the Build canvas. Service lines with ids from the live SOW tool (sow/index.html CATALOG) keep their names, hours and sources from there; researched lines come from canvas/research/*.json. 'lines' are on when the play starts, 'more' are optional. Each play lists its products, their places ([column, row] on the canvas grid) and any optional lines it turns on from the start ('on'). The custom play, Create your own play, lists the products a partner can add and their places on its grid; the canvas packs the chosen ones together.
